description: Taylor's agent skills: issue-native spec-driven development (setup-syn54x-skills, to-tickets-plus, build-epic, implement-issue, review-pr, review-panel, sync-progress, close-epic) with agents and hooks for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, plus scaffold-python-project, scaffold-frontend-project, prepare-release-notes, adhd and eli5.

interface.shortDescription: Issue-native SDD workflow plus scaffolding and writing skills.
interface.longDescription: Taylor's agent skills. The SDD set: to-tickets-plus hardens sub-issues with Files owned / Interfaces / Test scenarios / Verify, build-epic dispatches isolated workers in waves and gates each PR with a fresh reviewer, implement-issue runs one ticket to a PR, review-panel gates the PR to main with a persona panel, close-epic writes the summary; hooks refuse to stop without a recorded Verify run and refuse to remove a worktree with unpushed work (Codex has no custom-agent slot yet, so workers are plain subagent delegations). Also: scaffold-python-project, scaffold-frontend-project, prepare-release-notes, adhd, eli5.
